notes.title: Some New Minor Updates for Kingdom of Dinza
notes.content:
Hello brave adventurers!

In this update we will cover the latest quality of life changes to the game:

[list]
[*] Staying for a few seconds near the campfire will heal your knight
[*] Eliminated the loading screen entirely for death's in the world
[*] Eliminated the loading screen entirely when using the Compass item to teleport back to camp
[*] Additional minor bug fixes and stability issues were also addressed
[/list] 

That's it for now!
Keep adventuring and stay safe!

notes.title: What's next for Kingdom of Dinza?
notes.content:
Hello brave adventurers!
How is your journey through the Kingdom of Dinza been treating you?
Over the next few weeks there will be some updates to the game, some minor some large, and we wanted to give you guys and gals a glimpse of what’s to come:
[list]
[*] Lady Knight joins the adventure! Players will be able to play as Lady Knight with a full set of customization options!
[*] World bosses! 
[*] Player pets!
[/list]
These and more will be coming soon so keep playing and we’ll see you in the Kingdom!
